expectedActual.expected: Accept only exact configured native transport + matching current/legacy one-shot lease authority.
expectedActual.actual: Configured identity hashes into valid, unambiguous private bus name. Exact two-argument callback parser rejects oversized/multiple/extra-ID input. Real D-Bus test accepts primary code and legacy sanitized denial, rejects foreign state/replay and pending valid callback after stop.

expectedActual.expected: Do not publish raw OAuth callback URLs, codes, state or arbitrary provider errors.
expectedActual.actual: Optional deep-link plugin feature disabled; native closure validates before private forwarding. Bus regression observes zero deep-link://new-url events; denial outcome contains only status:denied.

expectedActual.expected: Raw work completion cannot strand native lease retirement.
expectedActual.actual: Review found Notify::notify_waiters race when waiter registered after active-count inspection. Fixed enable-before-check pattern; 128 concurrent raw completion/retire iterations pass. No deterministic pre-fix failing reproduction is claimed.

expectedActual.expected: Do not select final identity or steal Electron current/legacy handlers.
expectedActual.actual: No config/scheme/OS registration edit. Custom registration still refused by production owner; global oauthBrowser unavailable. Plugin only on Linux; missing session bus permits ordinary startup and is not callback-transport attestation.
